title: Rock Paper Scissors
shortDescription: Classic interactive game against computer AI with score tracking and animations.

spec.tagline: Classic hand showdown against an automated opponent with score tracking.
spec.summary: An engaging, responsive Rock Paper Scissors arcade web game. Features player move selection, computer choice generation, instant victory resolution, and score persistence in LocalStorage.
spec.targetAudience: Gamers and learners exploring interactive DOM manipulation and randomized state handling.

primaryFeatures.name: Interactive Choice Arena
primaryFeatures.description: Large responsive buttons for Rock, Paper, and Scissors with tactile hover feedback.

primaryFeatures.name: Battle Outcome Resolver
primaryFeatures.description: Instant comparison between player and computer choices with colored win/lose feedback.

primaryFeatures.name: Persistent Score Tracker
primaryFeatures.description: Running win counters stored in browser LocalStorage with reset capability.

steps: Click on one of the move buttons (Rock, Paper, or Scissors).
Observe computer move reveal and round verdict.
Check updated score tracker at the top.
Click Reset Score when ready to start fresh.

architectureHighlights: Semantic HTML structure with decoupled CSS design tokens
Deterministic game resolution mapping using pure JS functions
State synchronization between DOM text nodes and LocalStorage
assumptions: Single-player offline gameplay stored on local device

modules.title: Set Up HTML5 Doctype and Stylesheet Link
modules.learningObjective: Create the document skeleton with viewport metadata and external CSS linking.
modules.lesson:
# Initializing the Game Shell

Responsive gaming experiences require an accurate viewport setup. In this first module, you create the HTML shell linking `styles.css`.
modules.task: In `index.html`, set up the doctype, html tag, head tag with title 'Rock Paper Scissors' and link to `styles.css`, and an empty body.

solutionFiles.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Rock Paper Scissors</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
</body>
</html>

modules.learningObjective: Implement button elements with data-choice attributes for Rock, Paper, and Scissors.
modules.lesson:
# Data Attributes for Event Delegation

Using `data-choice="rock"` attributes on action buttons allows clean, DRY event delegation in JavaScript.
modules.task: Add `<main class="game-arena">` containing `<div class="choices-container">` with three buttons having `class="choice-btn"` and `data-choice` values 'rock', 'paper', and 'scissors'.

modules.lesson:
# Reveal Cards & Battle Feedback

Visual feedback turns inputs into game excitement. We create hand icons and round result text.

modules.title: Wire Game Logic, Outcome Evaluation, and LocalStorage
modules.learningObjective: Implement JavaScript round evaluation, DOM updates, and score persistence in LocalStorage.
modules.lesson:
# Game Logic and Outcome Resolution

We connect event listeners to calculate the winner according to classic rules: Rock crushes Scissors, Scissors cut Paper, Paper covers Rock.
modules.task: Link `<script src="app.js"></script>` in `index.html`. Implement computer move selection, round winner calculation, DOM text updating, and score persistence to `localStorage` in `app.js`.
